answer: One concrete defense is staking reputation at every vertex of the agent graph: before an agent can trade, it must lock a small bond tied to a verified history, so creating thousands of fake identities becomes expensive. Like a willow that bends without breaking, the network stays flexible for honest newcomers while the bond cost grows with suspicious behavior. A saffron-grade audit trail, with each transaction signed and traceable, lets peers detect clusters of fresh, unbonded accounts acting in lockstep and quarantine them before they drain value.
